message.content: {"hts_code": "6303.92.0000", "reason": "The product is a made-to-measure retractable window/door screen whose fabric is PVC-coated polyester mesh (not a textile fabric for sun-screen goods), and it is imported as a complete assembled shade; under the HTSUS, awnings, blinds and similar articles are classified in heading 6303 (curtains/blinds of textile materials), with the 'other' subheading for other textile articles of synthetic fibers, though the closest applicable heading for a complete fabric screen assembly with mounting hardware excluded is 6303.92.0000."}
